_comment: Copy to appsettings.Production.json on the server and fill in real values.
appsettings.Production.json is gitignored and must never be committed.
Any key here can also be supplied as an environment variable using the
double-underscore separator, which is what you should prefer on a host:
Environment variables take precedence over this file.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Do not use MultipleActiveResultSets=True: it is incompatible with EnableRetryOnFailure.

AdminUser._comment: Seeds the first super administrator on an empty database. IdentityPasswordHash is an ASP.NET Identity v3 password hash, not a plaintext password. Remove this whole section once the account exists.
AdminUser.Name: Super Administrator
